name: TDspYmfm
description: Yamaha FM chip emulation (Aaron Giles' ymfm) exposed as a Teensy Audio Library source. v1 wraps the OPM (YM2151, 8ch x 4-op) as AudioSynthYmfmOPM: a MIDI-playable, patch-driven stereo synth. Vendors only the pure-FM core (no ADPCM/PCM/OPL/OPN), so no external ROM interface is needed. ymfm is BSD-3-Clause, so a ymfm-only build carries no GPL obligation.
